# Primegram Extreme

> Primegram Extreme is a social networking web app for sharing photos and short videos, messaging friends, exploring music, and discovering creators and communities.

## Public identity

- Canonical website: https://primegram.com/
- Product name: Primegram Extreme
- Category: Social networking, short-form video, messaging, music discovery, creator communities
- Primary language: English
- Public crawl policy: https://primegram.com/robots.txt
- Sitemap: https://primegram.com/sitemap.xml

## Public description

Primegram Extreme brings social posts, Reels, direct messages, music discovery, creator profiles, sports, movies, and community features into one mobile-friendly web experience. The public home page is the authoritative overview of the product. An Android APK is available at https://primegram.com/primegram-extreme.apk.

## Important access note

Account, wallet, messaging, creation, profile, and other app surfaces require authentication. Do not infer private user content, balances, messages, or account activity from this public description.

## Source preference

For current product details, use the canonical website and its public landing page. Treat user-generated content and authenticated application data as private and unavailable unless a user explicitly provides it.
